provenance.note: Every field below is either a direct transcription of an already-frozen number, or a simple documented arithmetic derivation (ratio, tier classification) of already-frozen numbers. No model was trained, retrained, or evaluated to produce this file. holdout_A was not reopened; holdout_B, holdout_Q, inference_qcd_1, inference_qcd_2 were not opened.

paired_bootstrap.method: Jointly-resampled (same group multiset scored by both models per replicate) group-stratified bootstrap, primary seed only (20260811). Diff/ratio convention: transformer minus/over DNN -- positive diff or ratio>1 favors the transformer.

BDT_CONTROL_0.note: 34-feature mass-plane-blind + mass-aware BDT, frozen at structured_model_phase3_part_oof_20260813_v1 / bdt_apples_to_apples_v1 protocol.

CUT_BASELINE_historical_RHH_lt_34.note: A fixed rectangular mass-window cut, not a continuous score -- no ROC curve exists for this baseline, only the single operating point it defines. v2 CORRECTION: two distinct quantities are reported explicitly and separately -- 'R_B_rejection_factor_1_over_epsilon_B' (1.9496) is this project's standard R_B=1/eps_B convention, directly comparable to every other model's 'rejection' number in this package; 'background_rejection_rate_1_minus_epsilon_B' (0.4871) is the ROC-curve-axis quantity (true-negative rate) plotted as the cut baseline's y-position in fig1_roc_curves. v1 incorrectly quoted the latter (~0.49) in prose as if it were 'rejection', which cannot be R_B=1/eps_B (a value <1 is impossible for that definition since eps_B<=1 always). Corrected here.

BDT_NEW_C.note: 55-feature (+5th-jet+pairwise) BDT. This is the model this project's frozen roadmap calls 'NEW_C' -- it is not a categorized (per-region/per-mHH) model; see the CATEGORIZED_BDT entry below for the audited availability of an actual categorized-BDT comparison.

CATEGORIZED_BDT.v2_audit_method: Beyond exact-name grep: read checkpoint.json policy flags, population/fold-count TSVs, and training-authorization status for every candidate found.

candidates_found_and_rejected.finding: Contractually defined ('historical two-model 52-feature baseline below/above m_HH=450 GeV') intending the SAME event universe/folds/weights as this benchmark, but NEVER TRAINED -- no downstream checkpoint directory or output artifact references these model names anywhere in docs/checkpoints/ (grep-verified). The checkpoint-directory chronology jumps directly from the cut-search program (hh4b_train_multivariate_cut_*, through 2026-08-10) to the CONTROL_0/NEW_C apples-to-apples BDT program (2026-08-11), skipping orders 5-9 of this contract entirely.

checkpoint.json policy.v2_training_authorized=false -- explicitly never trained. Population even if it had been trained: category_population.tsv sums to ~57,326 rows across 2 categories, vs. this benchmark's 1,042,397-row/441-source population -- incompatible regardless of training status.

REAL, TRAINED, evaluated categorized-BDT study (bootstrap replicas, category metrics, figures, LaTeX captions all present) -- but scoped to physical-significance category optimization (Asimov Z_A, signed physical yields, transferred/direct-QCD closure) on a much smaller, category-scan-specific population (~31,225 rows for the mass_aware/n=2 configuration alone, per category_metrics.tsv), predating (2026-08-03) and structurally different from this benchmark's TRAIN-only classification population (1,042,397 rows, comparison_weight_outer_fold_k training weights, resolved_selection_contribution_weight eval-only). Population and split are not comparable -- correctly excluded per instruction, but found and audited, not missed.

CATEGORIZED_BDT.conclusion: No categorized-BDT artifact in this project is both actually trained AND population/fold-comparable to this benchmark. BDT_NEW_C (55-feature, +5th-jet+pairwise) remains the closest validated, comparable artifact and is reported separately under its own real name above -- it is not itself a categorized model and should not be described as one.

FiveJetParTNet.note: Cited from the frozen Phase-3 report, NOT recomputed or retrained here -- reused as a reference per the authorizing instruction ('Reuse frozen BDT/FiveJetParTNet results as references rather than retraining them'). Late-fusion jet-level Transformer, not a pairwise-attention model -- do not conflate with the CMS-inspired transformer benchmarked here.

LBN_Lorentz_Boost_Network.v2_correction: v1's exact-phrase grep ('Lorentz Boost Network' / '\bLBN\b') MISSED a real hit: hh4b_train_fold_and_baseline_benchmark_contract_20260805_v1/benchmark_contract.json defines model 'lbn_dnn' (baseline_program order 8) as a 'Lorentz-boost-network classifier' (lowercase, hyphenated -- a different string than v1 searched for). This is corrected here: found via a broader, non-exact-phrase audit of checkpoint contracts, not grep alone.
LBN_Lorentz_Boost_Network.finding: 'lbn_dnn' is contractually defined to use 'the same event universe, folds, training weights, and evaluation gates' as every other model in that contract -- i.e., population/fold compatibility was explicitly INTENDED. However, it was NEVER TRAINED: no checkpoint directory, output parquet, or score column referencing 'lbn_dnn' exists anywhere in docs/checkpoints/ (grep-verified across all checkpoint.json files), and the checkpoint chronology confirms the project moved directly from the cut-search program to CONTROL_0/NEW_C, skipping this order-8 item entirely (same finding as CATEGORIZED_BDT above, orders 5-6 of the identical contract).
LBN_Lorentz_Boost_Network.reason: Planned-and-specified but never executed -- unavailable for a specific, evidenced reason, not because no such model was ever conceived in this project.
